question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **"behind".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **appropriate word **for the **blank (4)** is** "behind"**.
 
• The author is talking about **the footprints** which **we have left behind.**
 
• So, **option 3)** is the correct one.
